notes.title: Stirring Abyss Changelog v1.06.01
notes.notes:
Stirring Abyss Changelog v1.06.01

An update has crawled forth from the darkness... check out the details in the patch notes below:


General:

-The individual difficulty of an Endless mission is now indicated in its tooltip on the Map. Previously this was only indicated by the graphic of the mission node on the Map. (Note: The individual mission difficulty is independent from the overall difficulty of the game you select from the Menu before starting the game.)
-Improved the scaling of some sprites on high resolutions.


Balance:

-Missions on the first Map of a new Endless game can no longer spawn as the hardest individual difficulty. (Note: This change will not apply to Endless games started before this patch.)
-Enemy health has been adjusted to be lower on the first few Maps of a new Endless game. (Note: If you have an active Endless game from a previous patch, this change will take effect from your next mission onwards.)
-Salvage missions on the Endless mode have slightly longer timers on normal and hard difficulty missions. (Note: If you have an active Endless game from a previous patch, this change will take effect from your next mission onwards.)


Bugfixes:

-Fixed a bug where the Black Blood scourge would apply its full effect on enemy Ascendants, instead of a reduced effect like intended.
-Fixed a bug where the Black Blood scourge would not reset properly.

notes.title: Major Update - Harvester Patch (update 1.06)
notes.notes:
A [b]major update[/b] for Stirring Abyss is now available, introducing a new enemy type and new maps. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1178210/discussions/0/3113647550044148800/]Check out the full changelog.[/url]

[h3]MEET THE HARVESTER[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/9c700afabc1106dbeae5a3800ec6dddf64948380.jpg[/img]

It approaches in silence, lurking in the twilight zone where the electric glow of their lamps is drowned out by the eternal darkness of the deep ocean. Pupils dilate, the hair on their arms stands on edge, a cold sweat forms. The Harvester is near, and the fields are ripe with frightened minds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/f92843040a7768ab4dda35cd4e5c79cc1eca5d1a.png[/img]

The Harvester is a creature of nightmare that [b]feeds upon the Sanity of your crew[/b] and grows more dangerous the more it consumes. These otherworldly monstrosities stalk the deep trenches and ruins of the Abyss, ready to reap their unwilling harvest. Harvesters can be encountered in both Story and Endless mode, and will spawn in campaigns started before the patch as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/be3a3a1d24b0a76123f9bd9c411fe3133de0c976.png[/img]

[h3]NEW MAPS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/8f351c8c40c620713c526f27590ca80ff2f89204.png[/img]

For those players who have already thoroughly explored the Abyss, we are adding a couple of new maps for bonus missions - one new Seal Defense mission set on a rooftop plaza of ancient Akoratya, and one new Diver Rescue mission that sends you delving into the depths of the abyssal trench.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/90029e931430b534c99999adf6fccf4b07585343.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178210/Stirring_Abyss/

notes.title: Stirring Abyss - free demo
notes.notes:
[b]Stirring Abyss,[/b] a tactical squad-based RPG with an astonishing Lovecraftian narrative, [b]gets a free demo on Steam[/b].

Play the first few missions for free and continue from where you left off when you buy the full version.

https://youtu.be/oKu7TRWx1xI

[b]Stirring Abyss Reviews (81 Metascore):[/b]

A capable indie strategy title that does more with its Lovecraftian setting than most similar games of the past decade. - [url=www.gamewatcher.com/reviews/stirring-abyss-review/13230]Gamewatcher[/url]

The tension between preparedness and speed that the mechanics created is something that more modern tactics focused titles should try to replicate. - [url=www.softpedia.com/reviews/games/pc/stirring-abyss-review-531550.shtml]Softpedia[/url]

I really dig the way it embraces the aesthetic of the subject matter. The audio is thick and ominous, and the pulpy art style is a good fit. - [url=www.pcgamer.com/discover-tentacled-horror-at-the-bottom-of-the-sea-in-the-strategy-rpg-stirring-abyss/]PC Gamer[/url]

notes.title: Stirring Abyss - v1.05
notes.notes:
A new patch for Stirring Abyss is now available, including French localisation and other fixes.

[b]General:[/b]

- French localisation now available!
- You can now rename your divers. (Look for the small icon of a pen on the personnel sheet)
- Easy is now the default difficulty when starting the game for the first time.

[b]Balance:[/b]

- Reduced the crafting costs of most consumable items.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

- Fixed a bug that could cause Salvage and Extermination missions to immediately complete or fail on the first turn of the mission.
- Fixed a bug that could cause the Wards in the "Enemy at the Gates" -mission to become unresponsive upon loading a saved game or following evacuation.
- Fixed the "Continue" text in some story events always displaying in English, regardless of selected language.
- Fixed an erroneous translation for less than maximum divers selected for the Away Team in the Russian localization.

notes.title: Stirring Abyss - v1.03
notes.notes:
We've got a few more updates for you to enjoy.

General:

- Updated splash screen (splash screen is also now skippable; default key is ESC)


Balance:

- Increased the effectiveness of the 'extended rest' function on the submarine (it now receives a bonus of 10 healing on top of the normal rest healing)


Bugfixes:

- Fixed some additional rare issues with saving and loading
- Fixed a rare bug in the last level that could cause enemy turn to get stuck
- Fixed a bug that could cause the buttons in the gameover screen to not function
- Fixed translated text issues with deployed Air Tanks
- Fixed a bug that could leave a ghost diver in the mission "Sinking Reality"

As ever, thanks for playing!

notes.title: Stirring Abyss - v1.02
notes.notes:
This patch includes several fixes and adds a "save" button to the pause menu. Check out the detailed changelog.

[b]General:[/b]

-Added a button in the pause menu to save your progress without exiting to menu. Note that if you use it a lot you might want to delete some of your old saves sometimes.


[b]Balance:[/b]

-Fathomseers should no longer target Seals with Shared Fate


[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

-The bug that was still causing issues with earning mission rewards (especially in Salvage missions) after loading the mission from a save should be fixed for good now
-Fixed a rare bug related to Void Embryos that could cause the game to stop responding during enemy turn
-Fixed a bug that could cause a crash while loading back to the sub if your away team died
-Fixed a bug that could result in an unloadable autosave if your away team died
-Fixed a bug where Symbionts might not properly Decay after being loaded from a save
-Fixed a bug where boss health could be slightly less than intended on Hard in very specific circumstances
-Fixed a bug that could change which units were affected by Shared Fate upon loading a save
-Fixed a visual bug with boss health bars on easier difficulties
-Fixed a potential stability issue on the final boss of Story mode
-Fixed some texts in non-English languages displaying in English

notes.title: Stirring Abyss is out now
notes.notes:
[b]Stirring Abyss[/b] is out now. Loosely based on Lovecraft's short novel [i]The Temple[/i], Stirring Abyss is the story of a submarine crew which bogs down at the bottom of the Ocean during the Cold War. They are forced to explore the bottom of a sea where unspeakable horrors and tentacled abominations run rampant.

Stirring Abyss releases with a 15% week-long launch discount: check it out and Cthulhu-up your Halloween weekend.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178210/Stirring_Abyss/

[previewyoutube=bHfFhASCIEk;full][/previewyoutube]

Stirring Abyss comes with [b]13 Story missions[/b] plus side quests, along with a roguelike [b]Endless Mode[/b]. The game features [b]4 difficulty levels[/b], from Narrative mode, for players who are more interested in story and exploration, to Hard, which will test even the most experienced players.

[previewyoutube=oKu7TRWx1xI;full][/previewyoutube]

REVIEWS

"A capable indie strategy title that does more with its Lovecraftian setting than most similar games of the past decade" - [url=https://www.gamewatcher.com/reviews/stirring-abyss-review/13230]Gamewatcher[/url]

"Stirring Abyss is good. It is close enough to the formula set out by XCOM 2 that if you like XCOM 2 you will probably enjoy it, but it also does a great job distinguishing itself, serving as a tight, focused tactical turn based RPG that provides a lot of enjoyable gameplay in its relatively short play time. I greatly enjoyed my time playing it and was really happy that I got an opportunity to play it. Definitely worth checking out." - [url=https://turnbasedlovers.com/review/stirring-abyss-2/]Turn Based Lovers[/url]

notes.title: Stirring Abyss Traits Sneak Peek
notes.notes:
It is only one day now until [b]Stirring Abyss[/b] arrives and that means that it will soon be time to unleash the eldritch upon humanity. Before that happens however, there is time to brief you on some of the powerful [b]traits[/b] that can be had in Stirring Abyss. Powerful skills and mutations can only truly shine when cleverly combined with the right traits. Today, we will be discussing some of these possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/1ace92d18f51f854b009125d6d10a4bd29e1f8a4.png[/img]

[b]Sadist[/b]:
Ruining the very essence of your enemy’s minds with eldritch skills seems like an excellent idea. But the toll it takes on your mind may be too much to bear. That is where [b]sadist[/b] trait comes in. It generates sanity for every kill you make, allowing you to tow the fine line between deadly force combatant and mental ward patient more easily.

[b]Swift[/b] and[b] Ruthless[/b]:
Your close combatant expert needs two things. To close on their target swiftly and to really put that hurt in. This is where the [b]swift[/b] and [b]ruthless[/b] traits can bridge the gap. [b]Swift[/b] increases your movement speed, allowing you to close in on your target with terrifying speed. While [b]ruthless [/b]increases your critical chance with a melee weapon, ensuring those close encounters are also fatal encounters.

[b]Sturdy[/b] and[b] Masochist[/b]:
[b]Sturdy[/b] personnel take a lot more punishment than most as they enjoy extra hit points. Those extra hit points don’t just have to mean that you will live a little longer if that person is also a [b]Masochist.[/b] The [b]Masochist[/b] delights in the pain they take and have a chance to reduce the cooldowns of all of their abilities as the punishment they receive rises. Turn that damage into additional power that could save you in a desperate situation by combining these traits.

[b]Lab Rat[/b]:
The lab rat enjoys a boost when using all medical supplies. This can really stretch rare and critical resources out for much longer than you otherwise would be able to. Considering half the battle is the battle against dwindling supplies, the [b]Lab Rat[/b] may be a welcome addition to any party of divers. There may even be abilities out there that further draw out the Lab Rats true power…

There are many more traits to discover in [b]Stirring Abyss[/b]. We hope you enjoyed this sneak peek into some of our favourites. There are also many more powerful combinations to discover. Plan your characters carefully and bring out their true abilities in [b]Stirring Abyss[/b], out tomorrow on the [b]29th of October[/b].

notes.title: Stirring Abyss Skills and Items Sneak Peek
notes.notes:
[b]Stirring Abyss[/b] hasn’t got long to go as we gear up for the release on the [b]29th of October[/b]. Before that happens, let’s have a sneak peek into some of the exciting skills and items you can obtain and use in the game. Careful item and skill use will be the cornerstone of any survival strategy in Stirring Abyss. Here are some of our favourites.

[b]Brawler:[/b]
Outnumbered? Maybe. Outmatched? Never. Strike several different targets in melee range with blistering speed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/05d8c0140b085f4dcc897f12fc768aca9cdc5c45.gif[/img]

[b]Chemist[/b]
Not insane, just... creative. Sets off an improvised shaped charge, dealing damage in a cone in front of the Chemist. Damage falls off with increased distance to the target.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/979043cc068fb16d28653ca886879b935475679e.gif[/img]

[b]Clustershot[/b]
Fire a projectile filled with explosives, dealing a small amount of damage to the initial target. The cluster bombs attached to the spear then break off and deal heavy damage to the initial target and to all targets adjacent to it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/e2faaa5ebfa82fc1c4d96a1ddb24f45b03df820c.gif[/img]

[b]Geologist[/b]
Always ready to rock. Launches an improvised Test Charge that disturbs the silt of the ocean floor, resulting in a cloud of sand which offers cover from ranged attacks and increased Defense Rating to friendly units standing inside it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/ab4d200c4beb4f95d3a8ebafd245100362e35be5.gif[/img] 

[b]Shrapnel Charge[/b]
Sometimes the simplest solution is the most effective and military grade explosives are certainly both simple and effective.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/94c72e9a17eb875c838f2c1868b2bf725d601cdc.gif[/img]

There are tons more skills and items to use in Stirring Abyss, from arcane dark arts to automated defenses. Even humble flares will be a limited and precious resource in the depths of the ocean. We hope you are looking forward to getting hands on with everything[b] Stirring Abyss[/b] has to offer when it arrives next week on the 29th.

notes.title: Stirring Abyss mutations sneak peek
notes.notes:
[b]Stirring Abyss[/b] will be coming to you soon on the [b]29th of October[/b]. However, that doesn’t mean that you have to wait to get a sneak peek into some of its exciting features. Today we will be looking at some of the dark, profane, nebulous or even totally abhorrent mutations that you can acquire in Stirring Abyss. Remember, when you stare too deeply into the void, the void may stare back into you. 

[b]Abyssal Grasp[/b]
Transfigured by a blasphemous force, the body sprouts a writhing tentacle that grabs the target in a crushing embrace and pulls it to an adjacent tile. You will also gain the ability to strike out at your enemies with a tentacle strike. It may not have much edge, but it has a lot of power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/e3ab9daaed08a2348f350c9bfb63abe7300ae493.gif[/img]

[b]Colony[/b]
The diving suit is invaded by a teeming swarm of small predatory invertebrates, bound in symbiosis to the host. Enemies around the diver take damage at the end of your turn. You can also command the swarm to attack a specific target, disorienting it and dealing damage to it at the end of its turn. The Passive effect is disabled while the swarm is away doing your bidding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/0e97085e278110b6ff63311f18249e960e2ae451.gif[/img]

[b]Crusher Strike[/b]
You'll never need a can opener again, but you will also never be able to perform attacks of opportunity or to use Spearguns with your giant, club-like hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/18e7e1c61dd99295a4a4cbc2a9fc80fa67d449ba.gif[/img]

[b]Dark Reflection[/b]
Anger, fear and hatred given form. Reach into your dark emotions and summon a reflection of yourself at the target location. The reflection acts autonomously, attacking enemies using the stats of the diver’s melee attack and inflicting an additional slowing effect on its victims.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/949a7a76b7c012a8f47917c4af69306f41e43938.gif[/img]

[b]Macabre Gluttony[/b]
The flesh of the newly deceased retains a vestige of its purpose, a ripe fruit ready to surrender its secrets to rending teeth. Rend Flesh, devour a corpse and ingest the power contained within. Different corpses might have different effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/c7999056d2dbbb97454aad0856161f0d86cd1c39.gif[/img]

There are many more exciting mutations coming in [b]Stirring Abyss[/b] and we hope this brief peek into the darkness is illuminating for you. Get a hold of gameplay and feel the pressure only an entire ocean can bring on the [b]29th of October[/b].

notes.title: The best free demos from the Steam Autumn Festival
notes.notes:
Steam returns with actual hundreds of free demos for its Autumn Festival. I am but one woman, so I could never get through them all, but I have played what I would characterise as a lot over the past two days. My own personal labour of Hercules was undertaken so that I could bring you, the reader, a list of my favourite demos to provide, if not an exhaustive list, then at least a jumping off point.

I’ve got something for all of yez, gentle pals. Puzzle games? RPGs? Action? Strategy? Why yes, even that. I’ve got an EDM murder rave, dressing up in pre-revolutionary Paris, ripping up legal documents as a cute turnip, and rodents you should live in fear of. So many games! Your favourite is sure to be among them.

notes.title: Bestiary || Part Two
notes.notes:
The first bestiary post introduced you to Scyphozoas, Burst Pods, Murkfiends and Spineskulkers. This bestiary episode unveils more Lovecraftian abominations you'll face in Stirring Abyss: masters of psychic powers, corrupted creatures, and amorphous beings lurk in the dark and can't wait to drive your crewmembers to insanity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/9be6405dbf01faa0377fa04c5eec38a01a1d1591.jpg[/img]

[h3]VESSEL[/h3]
Scyphozoas in their deadly, mutated form. Corruption completely changed their nature and transformed them into disturbing monsters, willing to commit suicidal attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/2cc187db8069c4859e8f29ff91e272ba0d743571.jpg[/img]

[h3]VOIDSPAWN[/h3]
A being with untold, multiple forms, made of materials beyond the understanding of human science. It can entangle a human being like a cocoon, or protect itself with a tough, yet pliable shell. Crewmembers believe that it shares a connection with corruption, a slippery white material that covers the ocean floor.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/1a8f6510013de27ab3ea01424cb3b292ab3cc8bc.png[/img]
[i]Voidspawns in one of their multiple forms[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/ef7c3f372d09f55fe7b4c3ea1b38616a73b0f6f0.jpg[/img]

[h3]STALKING TENTACLE[/h3]
Reason suggests that a limb, when split from its owner, shouldn't have a conscience, free will or any sort of survival instinct, but Stalking Tentacles go way beyond reason. They seem to belong to a creature of some sort. Nobody knows if it's still alive, if it's still able to control them, or if it ever existed. When you suffer from hypoxia and you fear for your life, it's hard to tell the difference between imagination and reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/05b1e3796809bd7805c76c40cd0f4cc4d998c6c9.jpg[/img]

[h3]FATHOM SEER[/h3]
One of the most disturbing creatures of the abyss. It can connect human destinies and play tricks with your mind. Beware of the Fathom Seer: this profane shaman masters ancient arts of mind control, and can lead you to complete insanity.

APPLY FOR THE BETA

Answer the call of the Great Old Ones: Stirring Abyss is looking for beta testers. [url=https://www.slitherine.com/beta/stirring-abyss]Apply now[/url] and join the [url=https://discord.gg/WjVWnp7]Discord Server[/url] to support the development.

notes.title: Bestiary || Part One
notes.notes:
Meet the Lovecraftian abominations of [i][b]Stirring Abyss[/b][/i], the upcoming squad tactics game inspired by the short story [i]The Temple[/i].

In Stirring Abyss you take charge of the surviving crew of the USS Salem, a U.S. Navy submarine that sinks while on a top-secret research mission during the early years of the Cold War. The entire game is set in deep waters, which means you need to face terrible underwater creatures during your journey.

[h3]SCYPHOZOA[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/45eafc3f7a681356790770ab7361b72a566d278d.jpg[/img]

The [i][b]Scyphozoa[/b][/i] is the first enemy you meet in Stirring Abyss. In order to survive the depths of the sea, it developed unseen before attacks based on electricity. Deflate it with a speargun and your crew will be okay, and don't let it come too close.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/83f0264a26273fc4555ba0b5f04390fc6fd7b454.png[/img]
[i]A Smack of Scyphozoas. Spearguns can attack multiples enemies in line of sight.[/i]

[h3]BURST POD[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/9b5b9212d7450f96ab9e7d55ee9d901d2c6198e2.jpg[/img]

The [i][b]Burst Pod[/b][/i] doesn't like to be disturbed. When anyone tries to attack it, it explodes causing damage to everyone (or everything) in the surroundings. It doesn't know enemy nor friends. It just stands, maintaining the same posture until it gets provoked.

Splayed open, all that remains of the bulging pod are the shreds of a thin but tough shell strung between supporting spines.

[h3]MURKFIEND[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/28bdf0143300b67b740267a1b7cd29df967f44f2.jpg[/img]

The [i]Staggering Roar[/i] of a [i][b]Murkfiend[/b][/i] is one of the most threatening sounds your crew will ever hear, and it doesn't help your divers' nerves. Taking down this strong Lovecraftian abomination may take a while. Make sure not to leave one of your divers alone with a Murkfiend and try not to get too close: this species is a master of melee attacks.

[h3]SPINESKULKERS[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/e3a676cea46b922fdb580b466eb2be2110b876c3.jpg[/img]

Beware of [i][b]Spineskulkers[/b][/i]: they are masters of poisoned darts and they are experts of hiding in the shadows. Their long-ranged attacks can heavily damage your divers' health if you can't take them out in time. They should be a high priority target for the surviving members of your crew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/f6553ebfc2f32901e632655dd35e43452aec9cbb.png[/img]
[i]Three divers facing a group of Spineskulkers and Murkfiends. Divers can make Burst Pods explode to damage other enemies.[/i]

[previewyoutube=dFzIaoFz7XU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Stirring Abyss - Announced
notes.notes:
We're proud to announce our partnership with Sleepy Sentry in the development of Stirring Abyss, the second indie title to be published under the newly launched K-Project label. Stirring Abyss is a tactical squad-based game with strong RPG elements and a Lovecraftian narrative.

[previewyoutube=dFzIaoFz7XU;full][/previewyoutube]

Taking inspiration from the short story The Temple by H.P. Lovecraft, in which a German submarine gets lost underwater during the First World War, in Stirring Abyss you follow the horrifying destiny of the members of the USS Salem’s crew, a submarine struck by disaster whilst on a top-secret research mission in the early years of the Cold War. They find themselves surrounded by the ruins of a forgotten civilization, their badly damaged vessel lying stranded at the bottom of the ocean.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/83f0264a26273fc4555ba0b5f04390fc6fd7b454.png[/img]

Every expedition lives or dies by the strength of its crew. You have a diverse array of character traits and skills at your disposal, each opening exciting new options for both combat and story events. As you delve ever deeper, you may also subject your crew to powerful but grisly mutations; the price of survival is high, and no one escapes the abyss unchanged.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/f3eef4e16f0c0b2d6b5a8b48d2b26a48360ab96a.jpg[/img]

Check out the first impressions in [url=https://www.pcgamer.com/discover-tentacled-horror-at-the-bottom-of-the-sea-in-the-strategy-rpg-stirring-abyss/]this article[/url] by PC Gamer:

[i]I really dig the way it embraces the aesthetic of the subject matter. The audio is thick and ominous, and the pulpy art style is a good fit: Publisher Slitherine said Stirring Abyss is meant to be weird rather than scary, "inspired by classic board games and traditional RPGs," and it definitely has that look.[/i]

[url=http://slitherine.com/beta/stirring-abyss]Apply for the beta[/url] and join the [url=discord.gg/WjVWnp7]Discord Server[/url] to support the development and to deep dive into Stirring Abyss' tentacled horror before everyone else.
